data.description: Luxury customized offices | Close to exhibition center | Grade A
data.long_description:
Provident, in collaboration with a famous brand that is coming to Dubai, offers fully serviced and customised office suites at Al Wasl Plaza, Expo City Dubai.


  Positioned within walking distance of the Dubai Exhibition Centre, KOFISI Dubai is a landmark 100,000 sq ft managed workspace development opening in 2026.


  Designed for businesses seeking premium private office solutions, the project offers fully customised office suites tailored to your brand, team structure, and operational requirements — not co-working or shared office space.


  Features & Amenities:
  • Fully private customised office suites
  • Premium hospitality-style environment
  • Meeting & event rooms
  • Lifestyle club
  • Screening room
  • Concierge services
  • All-day dining outlets
  • 20,000 sq ft shared facilities


  Financial Benefits: 


  the rent per annum is all inclusive of rent, utilities, service charge, furniture, coffee/tea:


  • No fit-out costs
  • No CAPEX required
  • Deposit only to secure
  • Up to 90% savings on upfront costs
  • Up to 30% savings on annual occupancy costs


  Located in the heart of Expo City Dubai, surrounded by international organisations and global enterprises, this is a rare opportunity to establish your business in one of Dubai’s most prestigious commercial destinations.


  Limited office options remain available.
  Contact Provident today for more information.
